name: Runtime - Graphify Scripts Freshness Gate
contract_reason: Detect code-source drift in the bounded operational scripts graph every day without rebuilding the broad workspace graph or treating Graphify's zero-node JSON fixtures as a false failure.
description: Daily local-only Graphify freshness gate for the existing scripts code graph. It records code-source freshness in tmp/operational-graph-maintenance.json, ignores non-code fixtures that produce no nodes, and never rebuilds the graph, changes configuration, alters canon, or delivers externally.
stop_lines: The daily gate only writes its local proof packet; it does not rebuild a graph.
No broad workspace graph, configuration, auth, runtime, canon, portfolio, capital, account, execution, or external-delivery action.
No cron schedule mutation from this contract artifact.
contract_update_reason: Initial approved bounded scripts-graph freshness gate.
